goal: Add @mention support for comments in TUI and CLI with structured comment array

steps.verification_command: cargo test -p clickup-api && cargo clippy -p clickup-api -- -D warnings

steps.title: TUI Mention Picker
steps.verification_command: cargo build -p clickup-tui && cargo test -p clickup-tui && cargo clippy -p clickup-tui -- -D warnings

steps.verification_command: cargo build -p clickup-tui && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy -p clickup-tui -- -D warnings

steps.title: CLI @Mention Parsing
steps.verification_command: cargo build -p clickup-cli && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy -p clickup-cli -- -D warnings
